This '''Corellian fleet''' saw action as part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] counter-offensive during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] in [[3996 BBY]]. It halted a joint [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] offensive into the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] that had seen the capture of several worlds including [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] and [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] scored several key victories at [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]], [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] and [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] which helped turn the tide in the Republic and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] favor.
